title: PoS v1: simulation of Proof of Pseudonym, with the pseudonym recycling study
description: Discrete-event simulation of the Proof of Pseudonym protocol (Johar, Ahmad, Durrani, Ali, IEEE Access 2021): PoW/PoKW/PoET/PoP consensus comparison, the two-level private blockchain, pseudonym shuffling; PoP v2 (VRF election, Merkle anchoring, attack bench, deployment scenarios); and the pseudonym recycling study (vehicle-to-vehicle receivers, former-holder adversary, ledger attribution, issuance modes with authority load, insider linker, revocation-rule sensitivity, runs on SUMO traces). Every result in the repository is reproduced by the pop-sim command from the configuration and seeds recorded next to it.
